_note: The 250 stories, one per station. Fill in entries by number; anything missing shows the design's placeholders. Every text field can be one string or one per language: {"ru": "…", "en": "…", "zh": "…", "ar": "…"} (a missing language falls back to English, then Russian). Copied into the web build by pipeline/build_web.py (also with --skip-tiles).

_schema.opened: how many stories are open (1..opened); the URL ?opened= overrides it for testing
_schema.nextOpensAt: ISO date-time when the next story opens (drives the countdown), or null
